text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before running in the Asahi Hai FS. Narita 
Brian runs out of the nasal strip she 
always wears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting the most effective one, the 
Trainer bought every single type of tape 
in the store out of pocket. Narita Brian 
looked on in exasperation at the splurge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that massive amount of tape was 
also a token of her Trainer's trust—proof 
of the belief that she would keep winning 
against any opponent, and that she'd need 
it in future races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Attaching a new noseband, Narita Brian 
sharpened her focus and headed into the 
race.
